stage: F+. Empty-airspace retraction study, frozen before new runs
vehicle: SUPER + eight paired Qingyu bending elements; nominal E2 unloaded model; native EKF2 and PX4 v1.13 MC_PITCHRATE_I=0.40; F rotor allocation and 12 N linear max per channel.
time_zero: Full launch-support release. All trials hold the same world-fixed target and fly freely thereafter. No translation leg.
shape: Same 0-to-90-to-118-degree F ascent, phi=180 deg, from t=16 to 22 s. Hold to 24 s. Original half-cosine retraction over 4 s, slow over 8 s. Straight holds zero at all times.
pairing: Same seed for synthetic IMU, magnetometer and barometer. Noise sequence restarts at release. Fresh PX4 process per trial. Microsecond-exact PX4 startup/state cloning is not assumed; pre-activation and return-start differences are measured.
primary: Peak true 3D body-reference position error from t=24 to command end + 3 s (inclusive). Straight is reported at both matched windows. Report peak in the common 24–35 s interval as a sensitivity check, recovery endpoint, time-to-peak and extra action time.
secondary: Tilt, net/total curvature, min of upper/lower rotor force headroom at the actual four channels, saturation fraction and measured model motor allocation; gravitational pitch moment from model mass and pose, unvalidated in hardware. Use one 50 Hz trace plus 250 Hz wire for primary scores.
integrity: Native PX4 ULog -> HIL -> actual MuJoCo actuator(s), world pose and shape -> ROS bag: independently compare outputs, mode, time, sample gaps and dropouts. Model states never replace PX4 sensors.
interpretation: Only timing differs between the two moving arms. Retain all trials. Three paired sensor-noise seeds, same physical model and environment. Segment lengths differ by design. No gate or new controller is implemented in this round.
representative: 241118 development seed fixed in advance for video and detailed time series. Report all three paired seeds.
